dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: "It was classified as belonging to the same class and superorder as a standard demon king but was part of a different grandorder. The chipmunk demon king looked very fierce indeed."

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh. You're having trouble imagining what this chipmunk demon king might look like?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Perhaps I should ask Maalaus to help us.
